clue.text: Protect second vehicle, one found at the back

parts.note: to protect is to guard
a van is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A bodyguard calls up a second car to protect someone.
explanation.walkthrough: A guard's van was the rear carriage of a British goods train, where the guard rode.
explanation.definitionFit: The brake carriage for the train's guard was coupled last, at the tail of the train.

clue.text: A gross he arranged to allocate with others

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of these words are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A man organises the sharing out of a gross of goods.
explanation.definitionFit: To go shares is to divide something equally among a group, splitting it.

clue.text: In Granada, press kindly to night life

indicators.note: In says the answer sits inside the words that follow, running across them

explanation.surface: In a Spanish city, someone is kindly urged to go out for the evening.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across granadA PRESS KIndly; Granada is near the Sierra Nevada ski slopes.
explanation.definitionFit: Après-ski is the socialising in bars and clubs after a day on the slopes.

clue.text: One having a fling

parts.note: a fling here is the Highland fling, a lively Scottish solo step, not a brief affair

explanation.definitionFit: The Highland fling is a Scottish folk step, so a performer of it moves to music.

clue.text: Some envoy, aged 50,on the trip

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A fifty-year-old diplomat travels abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across enVOY AGEd; the 50 is surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea, so a trip.

clue.text: One other contest, say, for a beginner

indicators.note: other says the word One is made into a different arrangement
say signals the next piece is a word as spoken

parts.note: a fight is a contest

explanation.surface: Another competition is staged for a novice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'other' turns ONE into NEO, and 'say' gives FIGHT spoken, spelt PHYTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A neophyte is a novice or new convert, someone just starting out.

clue.text: Writing back about fighting in a crowd

indicators.note: about says the turned writing letters go around the fighting word
back says the letters for writing are read from right to left

parts.note: MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a piece of writing
fighting is war

explanation.surface: A journalist reports from the front line amid a mob.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns MS into SM, and 'about' puts it around WAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A swarm is a dense, teeming mass, much like a throng.

clue.text: Iron case damaged in the plan of action

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of these words are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A broken iron box features in the battle plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A scenario is an outline of how events may unfold, a planned sequence.

clue.text: One goal that has been converted in Africa

parts.note: an means one, as in an apple

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so the letters of goal are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rugby try is converted on a pitch in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: In rugby a try is 'converted' by a kick; here it rearranges GOAL into GOLA. The definition is a place in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Angola is a country on the south-west coast of the continent.

clue.text: Mother takes beast many a large bottle

parts.note: ma is a word for mother
a gnu is an African antelope, a beast
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

explanation.surface: A mother brings a beast and many big bottles.
explanation.definitionFit: A magnum is a wine bottle holding twice the standard amount.

clue.text: Elastic band held by foreign agent

indicators.note: held by says the band word sits inside the agent word

parts.note: a spy is an agent working for a foreign power
a ring is a band, as worn on a finger

explanation.surface: A rubber band is confiscated by an overseas spy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elastic band' reads as one thing, but 'Elastic' is the definition and 'band' gives RING.
explanation.definitionFit: Something springy bounces back into shape, just as stretchy material does.

clue.text: It is instrumental for Alpine cowherds

definitions.text: It is instrumental for Alpine cowherds

parts.words: It is instrumental for Alpine cowherds
parts.note: a long wooden horn blown by Swiss herdsmen in the mountains, so it is literally a musical instrument for them

explanation.surface: Something proves useful to mountain herders.
explanation.definitionFit: This long wooden wind instrument is traditionally played by herders in Switzerland's high pastures.

clue.text: Spare book

explanation.surface: A spare copy of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A spare player sits on the bench as a substitute, and to book a table is to set it aside in advance.

clue.text: A marine goes three feet first along part of a ship's spar

indicators.note: first says the three-feet word comes ahead of the other pieces

parts.note: a yard is a length of three feet
RM stands for Royal Marine

explanation.surface: A marine strides forward along a ship's rigging.
explanation.definitionFit: Each tip of a yard, the horizontal spar holding a sail, is called by this name.

clue.text: A mistake it is said

parts.note: an error made in speech, a word blurted out wrongly, so a mistake that is spoken

explanation.definitionFit: This idiom names an unintended verbal blunder, a gaffe made while talking.

clue.text: Cricket stroke from a private road

parts.note: off can mean from, as in taking something off a shelf
a drive is a private road up to a house

explanation.surface: A cricket shot is struck from a private road.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the off side is the side of the pitch the batsman faces.
explanation.definitionFit: An off drive is a cricket shot hit firmly along the ground on the off side.

clue.text: Discuss at the end of the speech

definitions.text: at the end of the speech

explanation.surface: Debate the matter once the speech is finished.
explanation.definitionFit: To talk something over is to debate it, and when talking is over the speech has finished.

clue.text: Shooter met a novice using an explosive alloy

parts.note: a gun is a shooter
taken as written
taken as written
L stands for learner, a novice driver

explanation.surface: A gunman meets a beginner who is handling explosives.
explanation.walkthrough: L is the learner plate on a British novice driver's car.
explanation.definitionFit: Gunmetal is a bronze once used for casting cannons, hence the link with firing.

clue.text: Go round and round in dire need having registered

indicators.note: in says the rolling word goes inside the reshuffled letters
dire says the word need is in a bad state, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: to roll is to go round and round

explanation.surface: Someone spins in desperate straits after signing up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dire' turns NEED into ENED, and 'in' puts ROLL inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Enrolled means signed up officially, as on a course or list.

clue.text: Neptune fully understood part of musical

indicators.note: the answer is understood to be part of the words that follow, running across them

explanation.surface: The planet Neptune is fully grasped by a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across nepTUNE FULly.
explanation.definitionFit: A tuneful piece is melodic, pleasant to listen to as music.

clue.text: One who fails to honour his class commitments

definitions.text: One who fails to honour his class commitments

parts.words: One who fails to honour his class commitments
parts.note: class here is a school lesson, so this is a pupil who skips school

explanation.definitionFit: A truant is a pupil who stays away from school without permission.

clue.text: One is barely recognisable in the camp

definitions.text: One is barely recognisable in the camp

parts.words: One is barely recognisable in the camp
parts.note: barely in the sense of wearing nothing, and the camp being a naturist colony

explanation.definitionFit: A naturist goes unclothed, so at such a camp a person is bare.

clue.text: Colleague sleeping?

parts.note: a business associate who puts in money but takes no active part, said to be asleep in the firm

explanation.definitionFit: The word means an associate, and a sleeping one is the British term for a silent investor in a firm.

clue.text: Resume is not quite accurate

indicators.note: not quite says the word for accurate loses its last letter

parts.note: precise means accurate

explanation.surface: A CV is not entirely truthful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resume' is résumé, a summary, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A précis is a short summary of a text.

clue.text: Improve arrangement of engineers and actors

parts.note: RE stands for Royal Engineers, the British army corps
a cast is the company of actors in a play

explanation.surface: A stage crew and actors improve the layout of a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To recast is to reshape or reorganise something into a better form.

clue.text: Rare of course

parts.note: rare in the sense of a lightly cooked steak, served as one course of a meal

explanation.definitionFit: Meat that is cooked too little is pink inside, the way a rare steak is.

clue.text: After a short talk, lease back possession

indicators.note: After says the lease piece follows the talk piece

parts.note: a chat is a brief informal talk

indicators.note: back says the word for lease is read in reverse

parts.note: to let is to lease out property

explanation.surface: After a quick conversation, the lease on a property is handed back.
explanation.definitionFit: A chattel is a movable item of personal property, something owned.

clue.text: It will return on the 10 th

indicators.note: will return says the word It is turned round

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Something is due back on the tenth of the month.
explanation.definitionFit: A tithe was a tenth of produce or income paid to the church.

clue.text: Made comfortable again in new surroundings

definitions.text: Made comfortable again in new surroundings

parts.words: Made comfortable again in new surroundings
parts.note: settled once more after moving house, so at ease again in a new place

explanation.definitionFit: Someone relocated and at home again has been moved and made to feel established once more.
